THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. "PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM IS DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE DUE TO LACK OF SERVICE WITHIN THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA", PER JUDGE MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS NOT PRESENT BUT WAS REPRESENTED BY LUBOMIRA RAYKORA--ACQUAINTANCE OF DEFENDANT, WHO WAIVES UNTIMLEY SERVICE IN OPEN COURT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
